cards.finding: Vintage publicly offers several specialty lanes, but lane-level inquiries, booked evaluations, starts, completions, capacity, and economics are not measured in the evidence pack.
cards.lever: Establish a lane-tagged specialty conversion baseline for the existing dry-eye, myopia, and specialty-contact offers before adding another service or making a stronger lane-ownership claim.
cards.impact_grow: Measurement unlock only. No patient or revenue forecast is supportable from public evidence.
cards.impact_math: For each lane: inquiry_to_book_rate = lane_booked_evaluations / lane_inquiries; book_to_start_rate = lane_starts / lane_booked_evaluations; completion_rate = lane_completed_plans / lane_starts. Plug measured counts into the rates after 30 days.
cards.proof: A 30-day lane table exists for all three lanes with inquiry, booked evaluation, start, completion, available-slot, and owner fields; missing counts remain explicitly null rather than zero.

cards.finding: Vintage publishes six-day hours, same-day emergency access, and online booking, but the pack has no call handling, live-slot, booking completion, cancellation, no-show, or unmet-request evidence.
cards.lever: Run a 30-day access diagnostic before changing hours, staffing, or scheduling templates.
cards.impact_grow: Diagnostic only. It determines whether a fixable access gap exists without assuming leakage.
cards.impact_math: access_gap_count = unanswered_or_abandoned_calls + booking_attempts_without_completion + requests_without_acceptable_slot; realized_gap_rate = access_gap_count / total_access_attempts. Any later sensitivity is measured_access_gap_count * tested_recovery_rate, not a forecast.
cards.proof: A 30-day access table reports call disposition, booking attempts, completed bookings, next-available slots by visit type, cancellations, no-shows, and requests without an acceptable slot.

cards.finding: The current official address and public service surfaces are verified, but directory consistency, independent review behavior, referral flow, and recall performance are not established.
cards.lever: Reconcile the current address across tracked public surfaces, remove or correct any stale entry found, and establish review, referral, and recall baselines before broader awareness work.
cards.impact_grow: Baseline and hygiene effect only. The evidence does not support assuming a stale listing, missed referrals, recall leakage, or a patient-volume lift.
cards.impact_math: listing_accuracy_rate = correct_tracked_listings / tracked_listings; review_velocity = new_verified_reviews / 30_days; referral_book_rate = booked_referred_patients / referral_inquiries; recall_book_rate = booked_recall_patients / eligible_recall_contacts. Apply future tested deltas only after baseline measurement.
cards.proof: A dated audit shows the current address on each tracked surface and logs corrections only where a mismatch is observed; the same packet contains 30-day review, referral, and recall baseline counts with named owners.
